race.comment: DE LUCA (10) sets the standard after a brave third in an FM BM64 at Murray Bridge, beaten just over a length after covering ground. She comes back to BM58 company and, while her 1200m record is more place-heavy than winning, that latest effort gives her a chance. Can measure up with the right run. OUTPOST (6) is the seasoned danger, backing up quickly after interference last time when seventh over 1200m at Gawler. Brings strong ratings at the distance and the veteran galloper can contest for a place. KISS AND KABOOM (11) resumes with solid 1200m credentials and a reliable record with Teagan Voorham, and her second two starts ago reads well enough for this. In the mix. ALL SHOT (2) should be fitter for his fourth first-up at this track and is proven at 1200m. Has claims.
